wages.text: Namvar has said she fights for better wages and has led union contract negotiations for city employees.
wages.quote: Leila has spent years standing shoulder to shoulder with workers — fighting for better wages, safer working conditions, and affordable healthcare.

housing.text: Namvar supports expanding affordable housing and removing barriers that slow housing construction.
housing.quote: Throughout her career, Leila has worked to remove unnecessary barriers that slow housing construction and drive-up costs.

abortion.text: Namvar has said she would protect and expand access to reproductive healthcare.
abortion.quote: I would work to protect and expand access to affordable healthcare services, including mental health care and reproductive healthcare.

tax.text: Wallis said he introduced legislation for major middle-class tax relief as part of his affordability agenda.
tax.quote: That is why I introduced legislation for major middle-class tax relief along with bills focused on lowering fuel and insurance costs.

safety.text: After a community member was killed on Highway 74, Wallis worked with local leaders and law enforcement to seek increased CHP presence and stronger safety efforts.
safety.quote: I worked with local leaders and law enforcement to push for increased CHP presence and stronger safety efforts along that corridor.

abortion.text: Wallis was the only Republican reported to have voted for a bill protecting abortion providers and providers of gender-affirming care from certain arrests.
abortion.quote: This year, Wallis was the only Republican to vote for a bill that seeks to prevent arrests of abortion providers or providers of gender-affirming care.
